items.description: The expanded College Football Playoff is official and begins next season. Here's what you need to know.

items.headline: Texas State meets Fresno State in Pac-12 play
items.description: Fresno State (5-4) at Texas State (5-4), Nov. 14 at 4 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Texas State steamrolls Oregon State with 600 yards, 5 TDs on the ground in 42-21 win
items.description: — Torrance Burgess Jr. ran for 196 yards and a touchdown, Davian Jackson ran for three scores and surpassed 100 yards rushing, and Texas State rolled past Oregon State 42-21 on Saturday night.

items.description: Texas State (4-4) at Oregon State (5-3), Nov. 7 at 10:30 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Boise State rallies past Texas State to remain Group of 6's CFP front-runner
items.description: Max Cutforth threw three touchdown passes in the final seven minutes in relief of injured starter Maddux Madsen as No. 20 Boise State rallied to beat Texas State 46-45 after blowing a 25-point halftime lead.
